### Details

#### `arxiv_api`: arXiv API

- URI: https://export.arxiv.org/api/query (probe: https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=all:peer-to-peer&max_results=1)
- Publisher: arXiv / Cornell University; reliability: primary.
- Access basis: public_api_terms; licence/terms: arXiv API Terms of Use apply; paper licences vary per paper; not reviewed (terms: https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/tou.html); terms verified: no
- Rate limits / etiquette: Reported: no more than one request every three seconds; confirm in terms.
- Coverage: Preprints in CS (networking, AI, systems) and other fields.
- Limitations: Preprints are not peer-reviewed.

#### `awesome_lists_seed`: Curated 'awesome' lists (seed: sindresorhus/awesome)

- URI: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sindresorhus/awesome/main/readme.md
- Publisher: Community-maintained (GitHub); reliability: community.
- Access basis: public_open; licence/terms: Per-list licences (often CC0); not reviewed; terms verified: no
- Coverage: Human-curated links into niche tool ecosystems; a starting graph for hidden-value expansion.
- Limitations: Popularity-biased curation; link rot.

#### `caida_catalog`: CAIDA data catalog

- URI: https://www.caida.org/catalog/datasets/
- Publisher: CAIDA (UC San Diego); reliability: primary.
- Access basis: public_api_terms; licence/terms: Per-dataset acceptable use policies; some datasets require a request; not reviewed; terms verified: no
- Coverage: Internet topology, BGP and measurement datasets.
- Limitations: Restricted datasets must be recorded as leads, not ingested, unless access is granted.

#### `codeberg_api`: Codeberg (Forgejo) API

- URI: https://codeberg.org/api/v1/ (probe: https://codeberg.org/api/v1/repos/search?q=gemini&limit=1)
